sources.title: Rich Whitehouse
sources.snippet: Noesis is a tool for previewing and converting between hundreds of model, image, and animation formats. It utilizes a robust plugin system, with support for native extension modules and Python scripts. The plugin/script API features hundreds of functions and interfaces which assist in developing new formats, tools, and visualization aids.

sources.title: Qwopus vs. Qwen3.5: Trading Accuracy for Efficiency?
sources.snippet: Qwopus uses a light, careful post-training recipe that preserves the base model's strengths surprisingly well while making it much more token-efficient. To test it, I benchmarked Qwopus against Qwen3.5 27B across multiple tasks, measuring both raw accuracy and token efficiency. The results are below. How Was Qwopus Trained?
